d: Aruba 4100i 12G industrial DIN-rail PoE switch with 8x Class 4 and 4x Class 6 PoE ports, dual 10G SFP+ uplinks, designed for hardened environments.

specs.label: Protocols
specs.value: VLANs, QoS, IGMP, SNMP, IPV4 /IPV6, TCP/UDP, OSPF

specs.label: Layer 2 features
specs.value: VLAN, Voice VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, Port Security, LLDP / LLDP-MED / CDP, Port mirroring (SPAN)

specs.label: Layer 3 features
specs.value: Static routing, RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, Inter-VLAN routing, IPv4 / IPv6 Dual Stack, Inter-VLAN Routing, Policy-Based Routing (PBR)

specs.label: Security features
specs.value: 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication bypass, DHCP snooping, Dynamic ARP inspection, IP Source Guard, Access Control Lists (ACLs), SSH

specs.label: Multicast
specs.value: IGMP v1, IGMP v2, IGMP v3

specs.label: QoS (Quality of service)
specs.value: Traffic classification & marking (CoS / DSCP), Priority queuing for voice & video, Queue Management, DSCP Support

specs.label: Security
specs.value: IEEE 802.1X Port-based Authentication, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), MACsec (128/256-bit encryption), ACLs (IPv4 / IPv6 / MAC), Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI), IP Source Guard
